items.title: 【中国宏观与市场｜2026-11-10】
items.summary:
【中国宏观与市场｜2026-11-10】

结论：国内偏多，今晚美国CPI是关键变量。
托底资金已经在真实买入，油价回落对成长股有利；海外市场已完全定价美联储12月加息，CPI若偏热，会先压美股AI链，再传导到A股光模块和算力龙头。今晚不因政策消息追高。

1/ 中国10月CPI/PPI：CPI同比+0.7%，核心+0.8%，均回落0.2个百分点；PPI同比+5.7%，扩大0.7个百分点，主要靠能源（煤炭+36.6%、油气开采+35.0%），AI也带动存储设备、电脑涨价。内需仍弱，涨价来自上游和AI。
2/ 10月出口：按人民币计同比+28.7%，前10个月货物贸易+20%，财新称主要由AI相关贸易拉动。
3/ 托底政策落地：央行11-03开展第三批互换便利，中信、中金、国信、中泰、中信建投等券商已完成首批买股；回购增持再贷款转为长期安排、利率降到1%；证监会表示研究优化融资保证金比例，"适度释放融资空间"。
4/ 今日盘面：沪指+0.08%收3663.72，创业板指+1.46%；两市成交1.50万亿，上涨4273家、下跌1149家。AI短剧、AI眼镜、机器人领涨，石油、航运、煤炭领跌。振幅为10月以来最小，市场在等方向。
5/ 油价：特朗普称伊朗战争"实际上已结束"，布伦特跌破90美元（8月以来首次），WTI约84.6美元，霍尔木兹油流基本恢复。
6/ 美联储：Waller支持12月加息25bp，CPI偏热可加50bp；市场完全定价12-09加到4.00%–4.25%；美10年期国债4.88%。10月CPI预期环比+0.3%（前值+0.6%）。

含义：A股下行尾部在收窄（真实托底资金＋融资放松信号＋油价回落），出口和PPI也印证AI硬件景气；风险在估值端，加息定价和接近5%的美债利率压制成长股估值，光模块是最拥挤、对美股AI链最敏感的方向。
我的判断：政策底更清楚，但趋势未确认，等CPI落地、看明天承接再加风险。

未来3天（北京时间）：今晚21:30美国CPI｜11-11美债休市、多位美联储官员讲话｜11-12美国初请、鸿海三季报（AI服务器风向标）｜11-13中国社融/M2、美国PPI｜11-15起外汇存款准备金率上调2个百分点。

——English below——

China Macro & Markets | Nov 10, 2026

Bottom line: China leans risk-on, but tonight's US CPI is the swing factor.

State-backed buying is now real money, not just a headline, and falling oil helps growth stocks. Overseas, a December Fed hike is fully priced. A hot CPI print would hit US AI names first, and that pressure would flow straight into China's optical-module and compute leaders. I'm not chasing policy headlines tonight.

1/ China October CPI & PPI
CPI +0.7% y/y, core +0.8%, both down 0.2pt. PPI +5.7% y/y, up 0.7pt. Energy did most of the work (coal +36.6%, oil & gas extraction +35.0%), and AI pushed up prices of storage devices and computers. Domestic demand is still soft; the inflation is upstream and AI-driven.

2/ China October exports
+28.7% y/y in RMB terms; Jan–Oct goods trade +20%. Caixin attributes much of it to AI-related trade.

3/ The policy floor is getting real
- PBOC ran its third swap-facility operation on Nov 3, and brokers including CITIC, CICC, Guosen, Zhongtai and CSC have made their first stock purchases with it.
- The buyback/holding-increase relending facility is now permanent, at a 1% rate.
- The CSRC says it will study margin-ratio changes to "moderately release financing room".

4/ The tape today
Shanghai Composite +0.08% to 3663.72; ChiNext +1.46%. Turnover was ¥1.50tn, and breadth was strong (4,273 up vs 1,149 down). AI short dramas, AI glasses and robotics led; oil, shipping and coal lagged. Intraday ranges were the tightest since October, so the market is coiling and waiting for direction.

5/ Oil
Trump says the Iran war is "effectively over". Brent is below $90 for the first time since August, WTI is around $84.6, and Hormuz flows have largely normalized. That lowers the geopolitical risk discount and helps rotation from resources into growth.

6/ The Fed
Waller backs a 25bp hike in December and says 50bp is possible if CPI runs hot. Markets fully price a move to 4.00–4.25% on Dec 9. The US 10Y is at 4.88%. Consensus for October CPI is +0.3% m/m, after +0.6%.

What it means
The downside tail in A-shares is shrinking: there's real state money, looser margin signals and cheaper oil. Exports and PPI both confirm AI hardware demand. The risk is valuation: hike pricing plus a 10Y near 5% caps growth multiples. Optical modules are the most crowded A-share trade and the most sensitive to the US AI tape.

My stance: the policy floor is clearer, but the trend isn't confirmed yet. I'm waiting for CPI and watching tomorrow's follow-through before adding risk.

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI to pay for data center power after election shows AI concern
items.summary: OpenAI reaffirmed its promise to pay the full cost of powering data centers as part of a series of commitments the company published Thursday, two days after voters at the polls roundly rejected the rapid expansion of AI. [...] AI companies like OpenAI depend on AI data centers to serve customers and develop new models, and they're seeking to build out as rapidly as possible to meet demand. In February, OpenAI told investors that it's targeting $600 billion in total compute spend by 2030, and the company has since announced massive data center projects in Georgia and Ohio. OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said.
